mapper.select: SELECT pr.record_id AS recordId, pr.rating, pr.goal, pr.assist, pr.yellow, pr.red, pr.own_goal AS ownGoal, pr.Match_num AS matchNum, pr.clubJoin_num AS clubJoinNum, m1.userName, p.position, TO_CHAR(m.match_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS matchDate FROM Player_Record pr JOIN Player p ON pr.clubJoin_num = p.clubJoin_num JOIN clubJoin cj ON p.clubJoin_num = cj.clubJoin_num JOIN member1 m1 ON cj.memberIdx = m1.memberIdx JOIN Match m ON pr.Match_num = m.Match_num WHERE p.clubOwner_key = #{clubOwnerKey} ORDER BY m.match_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Player_Record ( record_id, rating, goal, assist, yellow, red, own_goal, Match_num, clubJoin_num ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(record_id), 0) + 1 FROM Player_Record), #{rating, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{goal, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{assist, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{yellow, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{red, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{ownGoal, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{matchNum, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{clubJoinNum, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
mapper.update: UPDATE Player_Record SET rating = #{rating, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, goal = #{goal, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, assist = #{assist, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, yellow = #{yellow, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, red = #{red, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, own_goal = #{ownGoal, jdbcType=NUMERIC} WHERE record_id = #{recordId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
